279875408.description: This collection includes a variety of mineral and rock specimens from regions such as Oregon, New Zealand, and Australia, featuring samples like sandstone, quartz, pyrite, jasper, chalcedony, agate, and opalite. The set contains labeled display cards and individual identification cards, including a set titled 'Gemstones of Arizona.' Larger geode pieces in different colors and forms are also part of the lot. The items show minor signs of wear on some cards but are overall in good condition.

280015117.description:
Natural Specimen Collection
Geode and Mineral Rock Lot
Amethyst, Pyrite, and Quartz
Varying Dimensions
Natural and Enhanced Specimens
This diverse collection of six geological specimens features a range of natural and treated minerals. The set includes a notable amethyst cluster with embedded pyrite cubes mounted on a glass base, originally sourced from Park City, Utah. Also included is a translucent amethyst crystal point with a "Made in Brazil" provenance, and a vibrant red titanium-coated aura quartz specimen featuring a high-luster iridescent finish.
Includes large milky quartz and yellow quartz rough specimens measuring approximately 3.5 inches
Features natural amethyst druzy with cubic pyrite inclusions from a known Utah locality
Set contains a mix of raw mineral points, clusters, and a smooth polished accent stone
Condition:
Very good overall condition. Natural specimens exhibit expected geological textures and raw edges. The aura quartz coating is uniform and bright. The mounted Utah specimen is securely attached to its glass display base. Total lot weight is 1.0 lb.

279769654.description:
Natural Mineral and Crystal Specimen Lot
Quartz Geodes, Halite, and Rough Stones
5.0 lbs
This expansive collection comprises a diverse selection of natural mineral specimens, showcasing various geological formations. The lot is characterized by numerous split quartz geodes, which exhibit intricate crystalline interiors and druzy formations. Included is a specific specimen of Halite (Salt) originating from the Stratica Mine in Hutchinson, Kansas, providing geographic context to the collection. The assembly also contains crystalline clusters, rough opaque stones, and larger smooth specimens, reflecting a broad spectrum of mineralogy.
Diverse collection of over 30 mineral specimens including quartz and halite
Labeled Halite specimen from the Stratica Mine in Hutchinson, Kansas
Multiple split geodes featuring transparent to white crystalline structures
Individual specimen sizes range up to approximately 3 inches in length
Condition:
Very good condition overall with average wear consistent with natural specimens. The largest piece in the lot measures approximately 3 inches. Some specimens are in their natural rough state, while others have been split to show interiors. Labeled mine-specific samples are secured in plastic bags for preservation.
